scripts/i18n/check-escapes.mjs:3 gates the backslash-escape cascade only; no scan for the byte-split lead+continuation signature or U+FFFD exists anywhere under scripts/i18n, so a mis-encoded save passes every gate

pairs.registryProposal: Upward lesson for encoding-corruption-ratchet: this repo met a second corruption class every structural gate is blind to, an escaping cascade (literal backslash runs, scripts/i18n/check-escapes.mjs:3), which also FOOLED value parity into passing 27 untranslated strings because the mangling made them differ from the source. The technique names only the byte-split signature; the cascade deserves naming as a sibling signature with the same ratchet shape.
